notes.middleMarker: The red-team workshop moved to October 22 at 11 AM
notes.endMarker: Submit the reflection recording by November 3 at 6 PM
notes.content: Welcome back. Today we are connecting evaluation design with product decisions. A model score is useful only when the dataset represents the users and failure modes the team claims to serve. Start by writing down the unit of judgment: a response, a retrieved document, or a completed user task. Then separate offline metrics from evidence collected in a live workflow. If annotators can see model rankings, their labels may drift toward the system, so relevance should be recorded before comparing configurations. For multilingual products, do not average supported and unsupported language pairs into a single release number. Report the boundary directly and decide whether the product will add a multilingual model, maintain separate indexes, or narrow its promise. The red-team workshop moved to October 22 at 11 AM in Engineering 204; bring one prompt-injection example and one retrieval false positive from your project. During the workshop, teams will exchange datasets and attempt to find hidden shortcuts such as duplicated questions, source-language confounds, or answers always appearing at the start of a document. Afterward, freeze the reviewed cases and keep failures even when they make the score look worse. Latency measurements must name the hardware and build type because simulator results do not establish phone performance. Your final presentation should show one decision that changed because of evidence, not just a dashboard of metrics. Include consent and deletion behavior whenever cloud processing is involved. Submit the reflection recording by November 3 at 6 PM through the course portal; late uploads need written approval from the instructor.

notes.content: 第一条适用范围。本规范用于双语信息检索研究中产生的访谈录音、匿名查询、相关性标注和汇总指标。研究团队不得把参与者的原始笔记正文复制到共享表格，也不得使用真实姓名作为文件名。第二条编号规则。参与者在签署同意书后获得随机编号，编号表由负责人单独加密保存，分析人员只接触匿名编号。第三条本地与云端。默认在研究设备本地完成文本处理；如果实验需要调用云端模型，必须再次展示用途、发送内容和删除方式，并取得单独同意。拒绝云端处理不影响参与者继续完成本地实验。第四条访问控制。只有负责人和指定复核员可以查看原始录音，学生助理只能查看去标识后的查询及判断。每位参与者的撤回截止时间为十月二十日下午五点，在此之前提出撤回时，团队必须删除该参与者的录音、查询、标签和编号映射，并在三个工作日内书面确认。截止时间之后，已经合并成无法反向识别的统计结果可以保留。第五条质量复核。至少抽取百分之二十的用例由第二名标注者独立判断，复核时不得显示任何检索排名。意见不一致时保留双方记录，由负责人根据事先冻结的准则裁定，禁止为了提高模型分数修改答案。第六条保存期限。原始录音在转写核对完成后七日内删除，去标识查询保存到课程评分结束，汇总指标可用于最终报告。第七条事件响应。如果发生误传、权限错误或设备丢失，应在二十四小时内通知导师并暂停新的采集。所有删除操作要写入审计日志，日志只记录编号和时间，不记录笔记内容。项目结束时由负责人逐项核对本地目录、云端临时存储和备份。项目关闭证明须在十二月二日前上传，并附负责人和复核员签名。

notes.title: Practical guide to retrieval evaluation
notes.middleMarker: Freeze relevance labels before running configuration comparisons
notes.endMarker: Archive the signed evaluation report on December 8
notes.content: A useful retrieval evaluation starts with a concrete user task, not a model leaderboard. Collect queries in the language people naturally use and ask annotators which notes would genuinely help complete the task. Include exact wording, paraphrases, mixed-language phrases, and queries with no relevant result. Record source type and language separately so an apparent OCR problem cannot secretly be an English-model problem. Keep distractors that share topics, dates, or entities with targets. Long documents should place evidence away from the opening paragraph and should be tested at more than one position. Before measuring, document retrieval mode, embedding version, chunk strategy, top K, corpus hash, hardware, and build type. Freeze relevance labels before running configuration comparisons; reviewers must not rewrite expected answers after seeing which system wins. Report in-scope and cross-language cases separately whenever production does not support both in one vector space. Recall at five shows whether all required notes appear near the top, while reciprocal rank reveals how early the first useful note appears. Negative cases need their own no-result accuracy because adding them to Recall would make the denominator meaningless. Treat an empty result as correct only when the expectation explicitly says no relevant result. Latency percentiles must come from release builds, and phone claims require phone measurements. Preserve failures as regression cases after a reviewer assigns a cause. Do not add a negative threshold to the release gate until behavior is stable across multiple runs. End the report with limitations, consent status, and unresolved architecture choices. Archive the signed evaluation report on December 8 together with the frozen dataset version and reviewer notes.

notes.title: Capstone research journal
notes.middleMarker: The supervised pilot review is booked for November 12 at 2 PM
notes.endMarker: The final ethics memo is due November 29 before noon
notes.content: This journal collects decisions for the capstone so they do not disappear across chat threads. The project studies how bilingual students search personal archives when they remember meaning but not exact wording. During the first week I will recruit classmates from two departments and ask them to bring examples of searches that genuinely failed. The interview guide should avoid leading participants toward semantic search language. Consent forms need plain explanations of what stays local and what may be sent to a cloud model. Every query will be logged with an anonymous code, retrieval mode, latency, and the note selected by the participant. Raw note text will not be copied into the research spreadsheet. A dry run with two friends is scheduled before formal collection so confusing prompts can be removed. The supervised pilot review is booked for November 12 at 2 PM in Lab 3B; Professor Allen wants the recruitment script, consent screen, and deletion procedure available during the review. After that meeting I will freeze the evaluation protocol and stop changing relevance labels in response to model output. Analysis will separate exact, natural-language, and mixed queries, while cross-language searches will be reported as an architecture boundary rather than blended into the release gate. The presentation should include one failed search trace from every source type and explain whether extraction, chunking, embedding, or fusion caused it. A second reviewer will audit ten labels without seeing the ranking. All participant exports must be deleted after aggregate numbers are checked. The final ethics memo is due November 29 before noon and must include the retention table, reviewer sign-off, and a statement that synthetic fixtures are not real-user evidence.
